gaps.lead: We took a spare tyre in case the journey went wrong.
gaps.sentence: We took a spare tyre ___ went wrong.
gaps.explanation: in case + clause = as a precaution because something might happen.

gaps.lead: My advice is to check the contract carefully.
gaps.explanation: had better + infinitive (without to): had better check.

gaps.lead: We couldn't go out because of the heavy rain.
Cars must not exceed 30 km/h in this zone.
You need to renew your passport before June.
gaps.explanation: need + -ing = need to be + participle: needs renewing.

gaps.lead: I'm afraid this is the last tin of paint we have.
gaps.hint: run out of = have none left
gaps.explanation: run out of = have no more of something left.
